The Research Scholars MSc Program is a highly competitive program that offers Master’s students a unique research experience: In addition to the standard Master cursus, scholars work part-time on a research project together with PhD students and faculty, and receive a stipend for their research work from the beginning of September of the year they arrive on campus.

Interested students should apply to an IC Master program (December 15 or March 31) and indicate their willingness to participate in the Research Scholars MSc Program by checking the appropriate box on the master’s application form.
Scholars receive approximately CHF 1’450.- net per month (same amount paid each month on the basis of 65 hours per month at CHF 25.- gross per hour).
